## Verification / 验证

<!-- List the commands and results. / 列出执行的命令与结果。 -->

## Checklist / 检查项

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
- [ ] Behavior changes include tests.
- [ ] User-visible copy is available in `zh-CN` and `en-US`.
- [ ] Database changes document migration and data-loss risks.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private URLs, or local absolute paths are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests, type checks, lint, and builds pass.
